title: The tensor counit square on cochain representatives
statement: For a commutative ring A in Type(u+1) and a morphism f:Z -> W of schemes in universe u, let F be inverse image on A-module sheaves, L(F) its left-derived functor, Q the derived localization and g(P) the geometric representative [def-pur-scalar-pullback-representative-data]. For all cochain complexes P and R, the specified derived tensor comparison delta satisfies delta(QP,QR);(g(P) tensor g(R));mu_Q(FP,FR) = L(F)(mu_Q(P,R));g(P tensor R);Q(delta_F(P,R)). The statement packages this family as LaxSquareHδ. No K-flatness assumption is made.

source.place: Tags 07A4 and 0FPH; the tensor counit square on cochain representatives.

proof.text: Apply leftDerivedUpperStarTensorComparison_laxSquareHδ to the homotopy quotients of P and R. The quotient tensorator is the tensorator of Qh on these objects. The isomorphism quotientCompQhIso identifies Qh of quotient morphisms with Q. The components of mapHomotopyCategoryFactors are identities, so the left-derived counit components are exactly the geometric representatives. These substitutions give the asserted cochain square.
